deadline.value: Biology PhD applications are due 1 December 2026 (fall entry only); offers go out in March.

also.quote: Biology Biological Sciences Sciences Atlanta Doctoral Fall 2026 Fall 2027 12/01/2025 12/01/2026

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 with 19+ in each section (or 5.0 on the new scale), above the Institute minimum.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT (Prior to January 2026): 100 or higher total score. Minimum score of 19 for each section. | TOEFL iBT (After January 2026): 5 or higher total score.

ielts_min.value: IELTS 7.5 overall (6.5 in listening, reading and speaking; 5.5 in writing).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: 7.5 (minimum score of 6.5 each for listening, reading, speaking, and 5.5 for writing).

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor's agreement is needed before applying.

funding.value: PhD students are paid one stipend (USD 37,500 in 2025-26) via GTAs, GRAs or fellowships, with tuition covered; most are on GTAs in year one and GRAs afterwards. Students pay about USD 748 a semester in fees.
funding.quote: The current stipend for 2025-2026 is $37,500/year (~$3,125/month). It is important to us to pay the same stipend to all students. | The majority of our Ph.D. students are supported by GTAs during their first year, unless they have obtained a fellowship or are funded via a GRA.

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a master's is needed before the PhD.

notes: The same school also admits to the Applied Physiology, Quantitative Biosciences, Bioinformatics, Ocean Science & Engineering and Neuroscience PhDs (1 December deadlines). Undergraduate GPA guide: 3.6.
